title: GoForUmrah Auth Flow
description: A production-style authentication flow and business dashboard built as a frontend technical assessment for GoForUmrah. The project includes multi-step sign-up, secure sign-in, password reset flow, protected dashboard routes, API integration, and responsive UI implementation based on a Figma design system.
shortDesc: Production-ready authentication flow with multi-step onboarding and protected dashboard.

details.overview: This project was built as a frontend technical assessment for GoForUmrah. The goal was to create a modern authentication experience and a protected business dashboard using Next.js App Router and Auth.js. The implementation focused heavily on user experience, form validation, responsive layouts, and maintainable frontend architecture.
details.problem: The challenge was to build a complete authentication system that felt production-ready while maintaining clean architecture and a smooth user experience. The application required multi-step onboarding, session persistence, API integration, protected routes, responsive layouts, and robust form validation across multiple authentication flows.
details.solution: I built the application using Next.js App Router with TypeScript for scalability and type safety. Authentication and session handling were implemented with Auth.js (NextAuth v5). Multi-step forms were managed using React Hook Form and Zod schema validation, while Zustand handled temporary onboarding state persistence. The UI was developed from a Figma design using TailwindCSS, SASS, and ShadCN UI components to ensure accessibility and responsive behavior across devices.
highlights: Multi-step sign-up flow with validation and state persistence
Two-step sign-in experience with session persistence
Protected dashboard routes using Auth.js middleware
Form validation using Zod + React Hook Form
Responsive implementation for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Reusable component architecture based on Figma design system
Integrated external API endpoints with proper error handling
Built with Next.js App Router and TypeScript best practices
details.outcome: Successfully completed the frontend assessment with a fully functional authentication system and responsive dashboard experience. The project demonstrates strong frontend engineering practices, scalable architecture decisions, and the ability to transform Figma designs into production-quality interfaces.
